from large import chosen_value
from consumer import render


def test_default_returns_42():
    assert chosen_value() == 42


def test_negative_clamps_to_zero():
    assert chosen_value(-1) == 0
    assert chosen_value(-1000) == 0


def test_over_100_clamps_to_100():
    assert chosen_value(101) == 100
    assert chosen_value(9999) == 100


def test_interior_integers_pass_through():
    assert chosen_value(0) == 0
    assert chosen_value(1) == 1
    assert chosen_value(50) == 50
    assert chosen_value(100) == 100


def test_caller_rendering():
    assert render(42) == "value=42"
    assert render(-5) == "value=0"
    assert render(200) == "value=100"


def test_bool_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value(True)
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value(False)


def test_integer_subclass_rejected():
    class MyInt(int):
        pass

    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value(MyInt(42))


def test_non_integer_types_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value(3.14)
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value("42")
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value(None)
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value([42])
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value({42})
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        chosen_value(42 + 0j)
